title: Coordinate Thom map for the affine zero section
statement:
Fix a finite coefficient datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions] and $n\in\mathbf N$. Use $A=A_{E,n+1}$ and the realized coordinate Cartier boundaries of [def-pur-affine-space-coordinate-boundaries]. Let B be a separated finite-type k-scheme [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] with structure morphism a_B, and let c be a nonnegative integer. Write X for the ordered affine tower of [def-pur-affine-space-comparison] and z:B→X for its zero section. Define W_c as the c-fold ordered tensor product of the compared shifted Tate line, starting with the coefficient unit, so W_c=A_X(c)[2c].

Form the supported product of the coordinate boundaries using [def-pur-supported-cup], beginning with the empty unit and successively intersecting the closed coordinate supports scheme-theoretically. Transport the source to z_*A_B by the unique isomorphism from their total intersection to B over X, using the canonical support transport of [def-pur-supported-class-operations]. This defines the actual arrow cl_z:z_*A_B→W_c. The product at c=0 is the constant-unit identity.

Define th_c:A_B→Rz^!W_c to be the exceptional adjunct [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image] of cl_z, precomposed with the canonical proper closed comparison Rz_!A_B≅z_*A_B. Closed direct image is exact on this Noetherian domain, and the coefficient unit is bounded below of etale origin and W_c is bounded below. No invertibility assertion or arbitrary choice of an arrow is used in this definition.

proof.text: Preserve the existing support_closed induction, classSource_eq defining equation, target_succ defining equation and Noetherian complementary-open proof of zero_exact. Close classSource_nil and classSource_cons by unfolding classSource once and reducing the respective supportData equations; both sides are definitionally equal. No support identification or replacement construction is used.

For boundary_plus, the ordinary finite Tate sheaf is in degree zero, its shift by two is bounded below by -2, and exact comparison preserves that bound. For target_plus, the positive exponent is invertible by exponentUnit. The existing finite_etale_torsion_twist_line theorem implies flatness of its degree-one sheaf; flat_comparisonUpperStar_obj preserves flatness. The single complex of this flat sheaf has Tor amplitude [0,0]. The existing source lower-tensor estimate, in its isGE_tensor_of_torAmplitudeGE_right form, bounds its tensor with any bounded-below input. The shift-tensor comparison lowers the bound by two in the specified right-tensor order; no braiding is needed. Induct on the literal action recursion, beginning with the degree-zero coefficient unit.

Induct on tower dimension to prove that maps into iteratedAffineLine are determined by their projection to B and the pullbacks of all coordinate sections, using AffineSpace.hom_ext at each stage. Induct on the support list: the intersection immersion kills every listed coordinate, by the pullback equation and zeroLocusSubschemeι_appTop. The zero section factors through every coordinate divisor by liftZeroLocusSubscheme, and through their successive pullbacks by pullback.lift. For the full finRange list, let e.hom be the intersection immersion followed by the tower projection, and e.inv the constructed lift of zero. Coordinate extensionality proves e.hom followed by zero equals the intersection immersion. Monicity of the intersection immersion and the zero-section projection identity prove the two inverse equations. Monicity of zero proves uniqueness. These arguments apply also to c=0 and empty or nonreduced B.

The ordinary constant sheaf in degree zero is bounded below. Its exact comparison image has bounded-below etale origin by plusEtaleOrigin_mapDerivedCategory_obj. Transport this property through mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor to obtain unit_origin for the specified pro-etale coefficient unit. Retain the actual supported cup recursion, its unique support transport, the canonical proper closed comparison and the exceptional Hom equivalence. Generic construction helpers cache the same list fold, equality transports, supported composite, closed-single comparison and exceptional adjunct in this module; their bodies contain no proof holes and their specialization preserves the original maps.
